title: Scimitar of Cinder
summary: Summoned Fire Myrmidon’s +3 scimitar adds Fire damage and can Burn.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 + 3 Slashing plus applicable ability modifier and 1d6 Fire. +3 to attack rolls. The NPC variant lacks the enchantment and extra Fire.
fields.Scorching Strike: Action, melee weapon hit adds 1d10 Fire. A failed DC 13 Constitution save applies Burning for 2 turns. No rest recharge.
fields.Availability: Fire Myrmidon equipment. Unobtainable by normal player acquisition because the creature is Permanently Armed.
fields.Base value: 30 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
